not_applicable.JEV: No language-token probability or scoring task.

backend_split: Projections/attention have device paths; CPU text relative-bias attention, normalization/RoPE/modulation/layout and decoder depthwise convolution (shared Vulkan Conv3D lacks groups > 1). Strict projection errors do not silently fall back.

case_summary.scope: Historical original-wrapper tiny 16x16 / 5-frame matrix; extended cases and corrected-wrapper replacement-host reruns are separate

shared_capability_follow_up.layer: S1 shared operators after this model PR
shared_capability_follow_up.reason: Existing Vulkan Conv3D rejects groups > 1; a model-local adapter cannot provide the missing shared kernel. Decoder projections use the device, depthwise convolution stays on CPU.

shared_capability_follow_up.capability: GPU attention without full CPU duplicate work
shared_capability_follow_up.reason: Existing runtime checks the entire CPU attention because device results can be stale. This model preserves that correctness check; GPU attention executes but substantial CPU work remains.
